name: – Daniel Freund – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Commission spent the 2024 European Union budget, and the budgets of six executive agencies and the European Development Funds. It also closes the accounts for that year. Alongside this approval, it lists problems it wants fixed: money paid out in error, weak checks in some countries, and too little transparency about who finally receives European Union money. The report is a set of decisions and recommendations, not a new law.

- **What changes:** The 2024 accounts are formally closed and spending is approved; no new rules are created.
- **Who it affects:** The European Commission, six executive agencies, and countries and groups receiving European Union money.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must act on the recommendations, such as publishing who receives money and fixing weak controls.
